name: multi-llm
description: Orchestrate plan reviews, task generation, implementation and code reviews across several LLM CLIs in parallel, or ask every model one free-text question about a plan.

interface.shortDescription: Review plans and code with several LLM CLIs in parallel.
interface.longDescription: Runs the multi-llm workflow inside a Codex session: plan reviews, task generation, implementation and code reviews fanned out across several coding CLIs in parallel, or one free-text question put to every configured model. A bundled stdio tool, multi_llm, composes the dispatcher's flags, supervises the run to a result and returns one JSON answer. Needs python3 and uv on PATH.
defaultPrompt: Review my plan with multiple models.
